name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor and physicist who developed Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) technology.

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Domain scientist and author of the essay on the history of ALD.

name: Jorma Antson

summary: Professor at Helsinki University of Technology who supervised Suntola's early work.

name: Tapio Alvesalo
summary: Head of the venture team at Neste Advanced Power Systems who suggested Microchemistry Ltd.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975 and co-founder of Picosun Oy.

name: Arto Pakkala

name: Ahti Aintila
